facts.fact: A MACRA director general's slide deck says Malawi recently joined Smart Africa as member number 33, and that the State President attended the Smart Africa annual general meeting in Victoria Falls in April 2023.

The deck says that as of September 2023 Malawi had signed two memoranda of understanding, with Tanzania and with Zambia, under its Diplomatic Data Corridors initiative for state-to-state negotiated IP transit terms.

facts.fact: ZICTA says operators in the One Network Area, which includes Malawi, cut roaming tariffs by 3 to 93 percent and signed new bilateral roaming agreements.
The African Mirror reports, citing BOCRA, that mobile operators in Malawi introduced roaming price cuts of 10 to 98.6 per cent under SADC's One Network Area.

Leyman Publications reports Malawi moved from observer to full member of the African Telecommunications Union on depositing its instrument of ratification, MACRA saying this gives it full participation rights including election to the Administrative Council.
